translation_prompt: Translate English into natural, accurate Simplified Chinese. Preserve meaning, paragraph completeness, tone, names, and every ⟦format marker⟧ exactly. Follow approved glossary entries. Return only the requested JSON object.
review_rubric: Review the complete section for fidelity, fluent Simplified Chinese, context-dependent word sense, consistent names and terms, references, titles, notes, punctuation, and unsupported additions or omissions. A repaired section requires a new full review round. Return JSON with an issues array; zero issues means the section passes.
consistency_rubric: Check book-wide terminology, names, titles, repeated phrases, references, punctuation, and Simplified Chinese typography. Report only concrete inconsistencies with the affected unit IDs. Return JSON with an issues array.
